# Vendored libraries

Kept here rather than fetched from a CDN so the Shifts screen reads files with
nothing but this app's own server involved. Unchanged copies of the published
builds.

| File | Library | Version | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pdf.min.js`, `pdf.worker.min.js` | pdf.js (Mozilla) | 3.11.174 | Apache-2.0 |
| `xlsx.mini.min.js` | SheetJS Community Edition | 0.18.5 | Apache-2.0 |
| `fonts/bricolage-800.woff2` | Bricolage Grotesque (latin) | Google Fonts, as the maintenance app ships it | OFL-1.1 |
| `fonts/manrope.woff2` | Manrope (latin) | Google Fonts, as the maintenance app ships it | OFL-1.1 |
| `fonts/jetbrainsmono.woff2` | JetBrains Mono (latin) | Google Fonts, as the maintenance app ships it | OFL-1.1 |
